build-server.py.source:
"""Build an ordinary server from an exact index tree; retain source and compiler provenance."""
import hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tarfile, time

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'write-tree'], text=True).strip()
source = root / 'source'
assert not source.exists()
source.mkdir()
archive = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'archive', tree, 'BasisRustServer'])
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:
    tar.extractall(source, filter='data')
target = root / 'build-release'
assert not target.exists()
# Copy the ordinary dependency cache; never overwrite older frozen binaries.
shutil.copytree(repo / 'captures/scene-batch3-client750-20261010/build-release', target)
environment = dict(os.environ, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target), CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0', CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2',
                   RUSTFLAGS='-Cllvm-args=-pgo-warn-missing-function')
environment.pop('CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', None)
command = ['cargo', '+1.99.0', 'build', '--locked', '--release', '--target',
           'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu', '-p', 'basis-server-console']
manifest = {'parent_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
            'source_index_tree': tree,
            'server_source_tree': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', f'{tree}:BasisRustServer'], text=True).strip(),
            'compiler': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '+1.99.0', '-vV'], text=True),
            'command': command, 'cwd': str(source / 'BasisRustServer'),
            'environment': {key: environment[key] for key in ['CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'CARGO_INCREMENTAL', 'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'RUSTFLAGS']},
            'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS': 'unset', 'pgo': False,
            'source_files': {str(path.relative_to(source)): sha(path) for path in sorted(source.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()},
            'started_unix_seconds': time.time()}
with (root / 'build-controller.log').open('w') as log:
    process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=source / 'BasisRustServer', env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
manifest['exit_code'] = process.returncode
manifest['finished_unix_seconds'] = time.time()
binary = target / 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/basis-server-console'
if process.returncode == 0:
    manifest['binary'] = str(binary)
    manifest['binary_sha256'] = sha(binary)
(root / 'build-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
assert process.returncode == 0, 'Server build failed'
print('Built ordinary frozen server:' + manifest['binary_sha256'], flush=True)

compare-peer-limit.py.source:
"""One ordinary binary, fixed 3-ms batching, per-peer queue limit 0/70; every failure retained."""
import argparse, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, shutil, socket, subprocess, sys

repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / 'scripts/perf'))
from avatar_benchmark import relevant_env, run_workload, select_port, workload_metadata, write_json
from avatar_tuning import run_order, sha256
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
from peer_limit_analysis import summarize
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('compare', repo / 'scripts/perf/compare-avatar-revisions.py')
compare = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(compare)
settings = compare.settings
p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--server', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--peer-limit', type=int, choices=[70], default=70)
p.add_argument('--repeats', type=int, default=2)
p.add_argument('--clients', type=int, default=750)
p.add_argument('--scene-interval-ms', type=int, default=50)
supplied = p.parse_args()
prior = json.loads((repo / 'captures/pgo-mixed-client750-20261010/setup.json').read_text())
args = settings.parser().parse_args([
    '--server', str(supplied.server), '--client', prior['binaries']['client'],
    '--output', str(supplied.output), '--clients', str(supplied.clients),
    '--warmup-seconds', '45', '--window-seconds', '60', '--repeats', str(supplied.repeats),
    '--server-cpus', '2-9', '--client-cpus', '10-15', '--rayon-threads', '4',
    '--tokio-workers', '4', '--client-workers', '4', '--additional-avatar-bytes', '128',
    '--scene-data-bytes', '128', '--scene-data-interval-ms', str(supplied.scene_interval_ms)])
settings.validate(args)
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {0, 1})
args.port = select_port(socket.SOCK_DGRAM, 0)
args.health_port = select_port(socket.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
args.output.mkdir()
artifacts = {}
for key in ('server', 'client', 'server_config', 'client_config'):
    source = getattr(args, key).resolve()
    destination = args.output / 'frozen' / key / source.name
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source, destination)
    artifacts[key] = {'path': str(destination), 'sha256': sha256(destination), 'original_path': str(source)}
    setattr(args, key, destination)
env, cleared = settings.clean_environment(args.server_config, args.client_config)
server_env = dict(env, BASIS_AVATAR_FLUSH_LANES='0', RAYON_NUM_THREADS='4', TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS='4')
client_env = dict(env, BASIS_CLIENT_TOKIO_WORKERS='4', BASIS_AVATAR_DIAGNOSTICS='true')
tool_paths = [pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve(), pathlib.Path(compare.__file__), pathlib.Path(settings.__file__),
              repo / 'scripts/perf/avatar_benchmark.py', repo / 'scripts/perf/avatar_tuning.py', root / 'peer_limit_analysis.py']
tools = {str(path): sha256(path) for path in tool_paths}
def power():
    return {'profile': subprocess.check_output(['powerprofilesctl', 'get'], text=True).strip(),
            'AC_online': pathlib.Path('/sys/class/power_supply/ADP0/online').read_text().strip()}
experiment = {'comparison_kind': 'revisions', 'comparison_dimension': 'BASIS_SCENE_PEER_QUEUE_LIMIT',
    'same_binary': True, 'batch_ms': 3, 'baseline_peer_limit': 0, 'candidate_peer_limit': 70, 'pgo': False, 'os_name': os.name, 'repeats': supplied.repeats,
    'coordinator_affinity': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), 'frozen': artifacts,
    'tool_sha256': tools, 'cleared_environment_keys': cleared, 'workload': workload_metadata(args),
    'invocation': [sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()), *sys.argv[1:]],
    'power_before': power(), 'runs': [],
    'invalid_continuation_policy': 'Retain strict delivery/error/shutdown failures. Continue only completed runs with continuous full-population readiness, fixed provenance and frozen artifacts. No gate is relaxed.'}
assert experiment['power_before'] == {'profile': 'performance', 'AC_online': '1'}
runs = []
def save():
    write_json(args.output / 'experiment.json', experiment)
    write_json(args.output / 'summary.json', {'experiment': experiment, 'runs': runs,
                                             'comparison': compare.aggregate(runs, supplied.repeats)})
save()
with settings.experiment_lock():
    try:
        for i, (round_index, variant) in enumerate(run_order(['baseline', 'candidate'], supplied.repeats)):
            selected_env = dict(server_env, BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS='3', BASIS_SCENE_PEER_QUEUE_LIMIT='0' if variant == 'baseline' else str(supplied.peer_limit))
            entry = {'name': f'{i+1:02d}-{variant}', 'round': round_index, 'variant': variant,

"""Add explicit admission-loss and queue-bound checks; preserve all original gates."""
import json, math
from avatar_tuning import summarize as original_summarize, interpolate_health_counter

COUNTERS = ('admittedRecipientMessages', 'rejectedRecipientMessages', 'enqueuedMessages',
            'dequeuedMessages', 'attemptedRecipientMessages', 'staleRecipientMessages',
            'sendErrors', 'enqueueErrors', 'queueBackpressure', 'fanoutBackpressure', 'sentDatagrams')

def admission_metrics(samples, start, end, limit):
    seconds = end - start
    if not math.isfinite(seconds) or seconds <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid fixed measurement window')
    rows = [sample['health']['extended']['sceneBatch'] for sample in samples]
    if not all(isinstance(row, dict) for row in rows):
        raise ValueError('Missing native Scene admission telemetry')
    for row in rows:
        if row['peerQueueLimit'] != limit:
            raise ValueError('Scene queue limit differs from selected arm')
        for key in (*COUNTERS, 'pendingRecipientMessages', 'peakPeerPendingMessages'):
            if isinstance(row[key], bool) or not isinstance(row[key], int) or row[key] < 0:
                raise ValueError('Invalid Scene counter: ' + key)
    for first, last in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        if any(last[key] < first[key] for key in COUNTERS):
            raise ValueError('Scene admission counter reset')
    deltas = {key: interpolate_health_counter(samples, end, 'sceneBatch', key)
                   - interpolate_health_counter(samples, start, 'sceneBatch', key)
              for key in COUNTERS}
    metrics = {
        'scene_peer_rejected_recipient_messages_per_second': deltas['rejectedRecipientMessages'] / seconds,
        'scene_peer_admitted_recipient_messages_per_second': deltas['admittedRecipientMessages'] / seconds,
        'scene_peer_peak_pending_messages': max(row['peakPeerPendingMessages'] for row in rows),
        'scene_peer_pending_recipient_messages_max': max(row['pendingRecipientMessages'] for row in rows),
    }
    offered = deltas['admittedRecipientMessages'] + deltas['rejectedRecipientMessages']
    metrics['scene_peer_admission_ratio'] = deltas['admittedRecipientMessages'] / offered if offered else 0
    checks = {
        'scene_admission_telemetry': True,
        'zero_scene_peer_rejections': all(row['rejectedRecipientMessages'] == 0 for row in rows),
        'scene_peer_queue_bound': limit == 0 or metrics['scene_peer_peak_pending_messages'] <= limit,
        'zero_scene_relay_errors': all(row['enqueueErrors'] == row['sendErrors'] == 0 for row in rows),
        'zero_scene_stale_recipients': all(row['staleRecipientMessages'] == 0 for row in rows),
    }
    return metrics, checks, deltas

def summarize(path, experiment, entry):
    result = original_summarize(path, experiment, entry)
    result['original_checks'] = dict(result['checks'])
    result['original_valid'] = result['valid']
    samples = [json.loads(line) for line in (path / 'samples.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    meta = json.loads((path / 'run.json').read_text())
    limit = int(entry['server_settings']['BASIS_SCENE_PEER_QUEUE_LIMIT'])
    metrics, checks, deltas = admission_metrics(samples, meta['window_start_monotonic'],
                                               meta['window_end_monotonic'], limit)
    result['metrics'].update(metrics)
    result['checks'].update(checks)
    result['scene_admission_window_deltas'] = deltas
    result['valid'] = all(result['checks'].values())
    return result

"""Verify admission drops remain disqualifying and telemetry integrity fails closed."""
import copy, pathlib, sys, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path.cwd() / 'scripts/perf'))
from peer_limit_analysis import COUNTERS, admission_metrics

class AdmissionEvidenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def samples(self):
        def sample(t, admitted, rejected):
            row = dict.fromkeys(COUNTERS, 0)
            row.update(peerQueueLimit=70, pendingRecipientMessages=70, peakPeerPendingMessages=70,
                       admittedRecipientMessages=admitted, rejectedRecipientMessages=rejected)
            return {'monotonic_seconds': t, 'health': {'extended': {'sceneBatch': row}}}
        return [sample(0, 0, 0), sample(2, 100, 20), sample(4, 200, 40)]

    def test_drops_disqualify_even_when_original_receipt_could_pass(self):
        metrics, checks, deltas = admission_metrics(self.samples(), 1, 3, 70)
        self.assertEqual(deltas['rejectedRecipientMessages'], 20)
        self.assertEqual(metrics['scene_peer_rejected_recipient_messages_per_second'], 10)
        self.assertFalse(checks['zero_scene_peer_rejections'])
        self.assertTrue(checks['scene_peer_queue_bound'])

    def test_peak_above_quota_fails_bound(self):
        samples = self.samples()
        samples[-1]['health']['extended']['sceneBatch']['peakPeerPendingMessages'] = 71
        self.assertFalse(admission_metrics(samples, 1, 3, 70)[1]['scene_peer_queue_bound'])

    def test_counter_reset_rejected(self):
        samples = self.samples()
        samples[-1]['health']['extended']['sceneBatch']['rejectedRecipientMessages'] = 0
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'reset'):
            admission_metrics(samples, 1, 3, 70)

    def test_missing_wrong_configuration_and_unbracketed_samples_rejected(self):
        samples = self.samples()
        samples[0]['health']['extended']['sceneBatch'] = None
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Missing'):
            admission_metrics(samples, 1, 3, 70)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'differs'):
            admission_metrics(self.samples(), 1, 3, 0)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'bracket'):
            admission_metrics(self.samples(), 1, 5, 70)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

def capture(directory):

        health = sample['health']
        sample['health'] = {'extended': {key: health['extended'][key] for key in
                                       ['appMessages', 'avatarSync', 'rawUdp', 'reliable', 'sceneBatch']},
                            'transport': health['transport']}
    return {'process_samples': samples,
            'run_metadata': json.loads((directory / 'run.json').read_text()),
            'commands': json.loads((directory / 'commands.json').read_text()),
            'ready_health': json.loads((directory / 'ready-health.json').read_text()),

                                if 'scene relay' in line or 'scene batching' in line or 'SceneBatch:' in line],
            'artifact_sha256': {file.name: sha256(file) for file in directory.iterdir() if file.is_file()}}

def retain(directory):

        saved['raw_runs'][entry['name']] = evidence

    for artifact in experiment['frozen'].values():

    saved['comparison'] = (
        {label: compare.aggregate([{**r, 'variant':('candidate' if r['variant'] == label else 'baseline')} for r in saved['runs'] if r['variant'] in ('baseline',label)], experiment['repeats']) for label in ('small_limit','candidate')}
        if 'variants' in experiment else compare.aggregate(saved['runs'], experiment['repeats']))
    return saved

          'controller_logs': {file.name: {'log': file.read_text(), 'sha256': sha256(file)}

"""Report matched quota A/B without counting deliberately rejected work as a speedup."""
import json, pathlib, statistics
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
path = repo / 'docs/performance/results/scene-peer-limit-client750-20261010-summary.json'
d = json.loads(path.read_text())
def arms(name):
    cohort=d['cohorts'][name]
    return [(('Unlimited' if arm=='baseline' else 'Hard '+str(70 if arm=='small_limit' else cohort['experiment']['candidate_peer_limit'])), [r for r in cohort['runs'] if r['variant']==arm]) for arm in cohort['experiment'].get('variants',['baseline','candidate'])]
def med(runs, key):
    return statistics.median(r['metrics'][key] for r in runs)
def table(name):
    groups=arms(name)
    lines = ['| Process median | '+' | '.join(label for label,runs in groups)+' |', '| --- | '+' | '.join('---:' for _ in groups)+' |']
    fields = [('Scene receipt', 'scene_observer_delivery_ratio', '.3%'),
              ('Scene p95 histogram bound, ms', 'scene_latency_p95_upper_ms', ',.3f'),
              ('Avatar p95 applied gap, ms', 'gap_p95_ms', ',.3f'),
              ('Applied avatar items/s', 'observer_applied_items_per_second', ',.3f'),
              ('Server CPU cores', 'server_cpu_cores', '.3f'),
              ('Server peak RSS, MiB', 'server_rss_peak_mib', ',.1f'),
              ('Raw UDP transmit, Mbit/s', 'server_transmit_mbps', ',.1f'),
              ('Admitted recipient Scene messages/s', 'scene_peer_admitted_recipient_messages_per_second', ',.0f'),
              ('Rejected recipient Scene messages/s', 'scene_peer_rejected_recipient_messages_per_second', ',.0f'),
              ('Maximum pending per recipient', 'scene_peer_peak_pending_messages', ',.0f')]
    for label,key,fmt in fields:
        lines.append(f'| {label} | '+' | '.join(format(med(runs,key),fmt) for _,runs in groups)+' |')
    lines.append('| All strict gates passed | '+' | '.join(f'{sum(r["valid"] for r in runs)}/2' for _,runs in groups)+' |')
    return '\n'.join(lines)
report = ['# Per-recipient Scene pending-work limit: 750-client A/B — 2026-10-10', '',
    'Rust now supports `BASIS_SCENE_PEER_QUEUE_LIMIT` (any positive integer) as a hard bound on pending logical '
    'Scene messages per authenticated recipient connection. It applies to the existing experimental '
    'batched unreliable empty-recipient Scene broadcast path. Unset/0 leaves this new quota disabled; '
    '`BASIS_SCENE_BATCH_MS` remains disabled by default and must be enabled separately. Both tested '
    'arms use 3-ms batching. Direct UDP sends, reliable/directed Scene traffic and the existing '
    'per-source byte-rate limiter retain their existing behavior.', '',
    'The quota reserves each recipient independently before admission to the shared inbox. A full '
    'recipient is refused while recipients with available capacity continue. A fully refused input '
    'does not wait for the inbox. Each reservation belongs to its connection incarnation and stays '
    'pending through inbox, collector, fanout lane and socket submission. Ownership releases it on '
    'send, stale discard, error, cancellation or queue teardown. It cannot consume or release capacity '
    'on a later connection that reuses the same numeric ID. Shared collector/lane backpressure remains; '
    'this bounds pending work but does not guarantee independent peer scheduling or end-to-end latency.', '',
    '## Interpretation and configuration', '',
    'A 70-message logical quota is too small for this synchronized 750-client workload: '
    'it rejects most Scene work and loses source coverage at both rates. Lower CPU and '
    'shorter received-message latency are therefore load shedding, not a speedup.', '',
    'At 5 Hz, the 1,024 limit keeps all 749 senders, peaks at 749 pending messages and records '
    'zero quota rejections in both repeats. It passes Scene receipt/quality checks in both; '
    'one process passes every original gate and the other fails only absolute-zero '
    'retransmits (2 already present at first sample, unchanged during measurement). '
    'Keep that strict failure visible: this is promising bounded-work screening evidence, '
    'not complete validation. The quota remains opt-in with default 0.', '',

"""Attest final source, available controls and each original measurement gate."""
import json, pathlib, subprocess

repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
d = json.loads((repo / 'docs/performance/results/scene-peer-limit-client750-20261010-summary.json').read_text())
tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'write-tree'], text=True).strip()
assert d['build']['server_source_tree'] == subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'rev-parse', f'{tree}:BasisRustServer'], text=True).strip()
csharp = json.loads((repo / 'docs/performance/results/csharp-mixed-client750-20261010-summary.json').read_text())
for name in ['evaluation-20hz','evaluation-5hz']:
    for raw in csharp['cohorts'][name]['raw_runs'].values():
        assert all(sample['health']['queuePerPeer'] == 3118 for sample in raw['process_samples'])
proof=d['csharp_queue_correction']
source_repo='/home/mgstange/.t3/worktrees/Basis/t3code-787627cc'
for file in proof['files']:
    object_id=f"{proof['frozen_commit']}:{file['path']}"
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',source_repo,'rev-parse',object_id],text=True).strip()==file['git_blob_sha']
    lines=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',source_repo,'show',object_id],text=True).splitlines()
    for excerpt in file['excerpts']:
        actual='\n'.join(f'{i}: {lines[i-1]}' for i in range(excerpt['start_line'],excerpt['end_line']+1))
        assert actual == excerpt['text'].rstrip('\n'), file['path']
count = 0
for name, cohort in d['cohorts'].items():
    assert len(cohort['runs']) == (6 if name == 'evaluation-5hz' else 4)
    work = cohort['experiment']['workload']
    ref = d['csharp_reference']['cohorts'][name]['experiment']
    for key in ('clients', 'warmup_seconds', 'window_seconds', 'rayon_threads', 'tokio_workers',
                'client_workers', 'server_cpus', 'client_cpus', 'additional_avatar_bytes',
                'scene_data_bytes', 'scene_data_interval_ms', 'scene_data_reliable', 'network_capacity_mbps'):
        assert work[key] == ref['workload'][key], key
    assert cohort['experiment']['frozen']['server']['sha256'] == d['build']['binary_sha256']
    for key in ('client', 'client_config', 'server_config'):
        assert cohort['experiment']['frozen'][key]['sha256'] == ref['frozen'][key]['sha256'], key
    envs = [entry['server_settings'] for entry in cohort['experiment']['runs']]
    common = [{key: value for key, value in env.items() if key != 'BASIS_SCENE_PEER_QUEUE_LIMIT'} for env in envs]
    assert all(env == common[0] for env in common)
    for result in cohort['runs']:
        assert all(result['checks'][key] for key in ('completed', 'continuous_readiness', 'coverage',
            'sender_progress', 'sender_errors', 'control_provenance', 'mixed_command_provenance',
            'frozen_server', 'frozen_client', 'counter_window'))
        assert result['checks']['scene_admission_telemetry'] and result['checks']['scene_peer_queue_bound']
        assert result['checks'] == {**result['original_checks'], **{k:v for k,v in result['checks'].items() if k not in result['original_checks']}}
        assert result['original_valid'] == all(result['original_checks'].values())
        if result['variant'] == 'baseline' or (name == 'evaluation-5hz' and result['variant'] == 'candidate'):
            assert result['scene']['metrics']['observed_senders'] == '749'
        else:
            assert not result['checks']['scene_quality'] and not result['checks']['zero_scene_peer_rejections'], 'Lossy70arm must stay invalid'
        assert result['exits'] == {'client_exit_code': 0, 'server_exit_code': 0}
        samples = cohort['raw_runs'][result['name']]['process_samples']
        count += len(samples)
        assert all(sample['players_online'] == sample['active_states'] == 750 for sample in samples)
        log = (root / name / result['name'] / 'server.log').read_text()
        assert 'scene batching enabled batch_ms=3' in log
        assert result['valid'] == all(result['checks'].values())
        if result['variant'] != 'baseline':
            limit = 70 if result['variant'] == 'small_limit' else cohort['experiment']['candidate_peer_limit']
            assert result['metrics']['scene_peer_peak_pending_messages'] <= limit
        else:
            assert result['checks']['zero_scene_peer_rejections']
        drain = [line for line in log.splitlines() if 'scene relay drained' in line]
        assert len(drain) == 1 and 'pending_recipient_messages: 0,' in drain[0], 'Drain must release every pending reservation'
review = [json.loads(line) for line in d['review']['log'].splitlines()]
end = next(row for row in reversed(review) if row['type'] == 'complete')
assert end['status'] == 'review_completed' and end['findings'] == 0
message = f'Verified {count} full-population samples across ten matched runs; exact final server source, shared controls/client/fixtures and all strict flags retained\n'
(root / 'check-final-provenance.log').write_text(message)
print(message, end='')
